mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label at the crossing of the graph axes). Right image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label at the crossing of the axes beside the parabola).
Rationales: In both images, O names the origin of the coordinate axes. The relevant locations are the label at the crossing of the graph axes on the left and the label at the crossing of the axes beside the parabola on the right.
